title: The Establishment Pulls Through: Five Takeaways from the New Hampshire Primaries
summary: The U.S. Senate race will feature familiar faces: former Senator John E. Sununu and Chris Pappas, a four-term congressman. Stefany Shaheen, a senator’s daughter, eked out a win in a House primary.
